column4: cleat#2663: dialect-gated per SUBTEST, one subtest per dialect via testutil.TestDB, same shape as TestAwaitEventClaimsOldestAcrossDialects' entry -- mysql and mssql call t.Skip in this PostgreSQL-only job (CLEAT_TEST_DB only) while postgres RUNS and drives the real backfill UPDATE against a v7-only schema. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_DB=<pg> go test ./plugins/eventtriggers/... -run TestV8BackfillPreservesTheOldSweepSelection -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly mysql and mssql, postgres runs.
